title: Retry build: reduce frontend bundle size and add subtle motion to selected UI components

requirements.text: Reduce the frontend JavaScript bundle size by approximately 90% compared to the current baseline, focusing on production build output (JS shipped to the browser).

quotes: Reduce the overall app size by 90% of its current size.

acceptanceCriteria: A baseline production build size (JS payload) is measured and recorded before changes.

After optimizations, the production JS payload is reduced by ~90% versus the recorded baseline (or the closest achievable reduction is documented with a clear breakdown of remaining largest contributors).
The app continues to function as before (no broken navigation or core workflows).

requirements.text: Implement bundle-size optimizations by removing or replacing unnecessary/heavy frontend dependencies, eliminating unused code, and ensuring large features are code-split/lazy-loaded where appropriate (without adding new third-party animation libraries).

quotes: Reduce the overall app size by 90% of its current size.

acceptanceCriteria: No new animation libraries (e.g., Lottie, Framer Motion) are added.
Large non-critical UI routes/components are loaded via code-splitting (lazy loading) when it meaningfully reduces initial bundle size.
No runtime errors are introduced in the browser console during typical use.

requirements.text: Make the UI feel more dynamic using simple Tailwind/CSS/React-based motion effects applied only to selected components (e.g., buttons and modals), keeping animations subtle and performance-friendly.

quotes: Make the app more dynamic (for example, use animated icons).

acceptanceCriteria: Buttons provide immediate visual press feedback (e.g., subtle scale/translate and transition) and consistent hover/focus transitions.
Modals animate in/out with a subtle slide+scale and a softened backdrop effect, without jarring motion.
At least one set of commonly used icon buttons uses lightweight animated SVG/CSS (no external animation libraries) to convey interactivity.

requirements.text: Resolve the previous build failure by ensuring the project builds successfully end-to-end after the changes (development and production build).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend canister compilation succeeds without errors.
The deployed app loads and the main pages render and function (Dashboard and project editing flows).

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).

Do not modify files in frontend immutablePaths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo); only add backend/migration.mo if an upgrade/state migration is required.
nonGoals: Do not apply motion/animation changes globally across the entire UI; limit to selected parts such as buttons and modals.
Do not introduce Lottie/Framer Motion or other third-party animation frameworks.
Do not add external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
